{"code": "import numpy as np

# Check how many rows have biomarker_final = -999.0
missing_final = df[df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0]
print(f"Number of rows with final biomarker = -999.0: {len(missing_final)}")

# Identify rows where either baseline or final is -999.0
invalid_rows = df[(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0) | (df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0)]
print(f"Number of rows with either baseline or final = -999.0: {len(invalid_rows)}")

# Remove all invalid rows for the change calculation
valid_data = df[(df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0) & (df['biomarker_final'] != -999.0)]

# Compute change in biomarker
valid_data['change'] = valid_data['biomarker_final'] - valid_data['biomarker_baseline']

# Summary of change
print("\nChange in biomarker (valid baseline and final only):")
valid_data['change'].describe()"}
